description: The drift guarantee, asserted as behavior: a lib member with no baseline entry floors. `Proxy` has none — the gate could not construct a receiver to probe it — so `new Proxy(…)` is reported, and a TypeScript release landing ahead of a `@no-throw/core` release floors its newcomers the same way.

diagnostics.message: Call to `Proxy` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
